name: 16-backup-artifact-summary
command: $files=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath H:\c03-005-runtime\backups -Filter 'apply-*.json'; $summary=$files | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { $data=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $_.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{name=$_.Name;fullPath=$_.FullName;bytes=$_.Length;version=$data.version;changes=@($data.changes).Count} }; [pscustomobject]@{artifacts=$summary;repoBackupCount=@(Get-ChildItem -Path . -Recurse -File -Filter 'apply-*.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count;literalDoubleDashExists=Test-Path -LiteralPath backend/--} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
